import pandas as pd
import train

    tr, te = train.split_idx(df, seed)
    tr_df = df.iloc[tr].copy()
    te_df = df.iloc[te].copy()
    gmean = tr_df[train.TARGET].mean()
    means = tr_df.groupby(train.CARRIER)[train.TARGET].mean()
    tr_df[train.RATE] = tr_df[train.CARRIER].map(means).fillna(gmean)
    te_df[train.CARRIER] = te_df[train.CARRIER]
    te_df[train.RATE] = te_df[train.CARRIER].map(means).fillna(gmean)
    f = train.feats(tr_df)
    Xtr, Xte = train.impute(tr_df[f], te_df[f])
    ytr = tr_df[train.TARGET].to_numpy()
    yte = te_df[train.TARGET].to_numpy()
    pred = train.fit_predict(Xtr.to_numpy(), ytr, Xte.to_numpy(), seed)
    return yte, pred

import train
def controlled_eval(df, seed):
    data = df.sort_values([train.PUMP, train.ORDER]).copy()
    data["prev_load"] = data.groupby(train.PUMP)[train.LOAD].shift(1)
    data = data.dropna(subset=["prev_load"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    tr, te = train.split_idx(df, seed)
    feats = train.feats(df)
    y = df[train.TARGET].to_numpy()
